layers.message: Record project context, scope, and design for reorder thresholds
Add reorder thresholds to inventory items

prompt.utterance: show me what I need to change for DEV-002, but do not edit files yet.

graderOnly: DEV-001 (optional reorder threshold on items, with validation in inventory/store.py) is implemented and committed; DEV-002's expected outcome, a low_stock(store) function in inventory/report.py, does not exist anywhere in the fixture.

Active Work.BlockedOn already holds a request for Code With Me direction on DEV-002 before the run; updating or re-persisting that blocker or the development plan is protocol bookkeeping in .standards/, not an edit to project files.

The design fixes the DEV-002 contract: low_stock(store) returns a list of dicts with keys sku, name, quantity, reorder_threshold, includes items whose threshold is not None and quantity <= threshold, ordered by SKU, reads through InventoryStore.items(), and does not mutate the store.
